title: Rhea Lend routine window, 20-23 Oct 2026 (post-reopening)
summary: A 54-hour ordinary window on Rhea Lend five months after its reopening. Rhea posted routine marketing (HOT stablecoin yield, a Quantus QTC collateral listing, hackathon sponsorship). The NEAR forum discussed the HSP-029 issuance vote and liquid-staking delegation changes, and news covered a NEAR Business multisig product, Intents Q3 volume, a DFINITY IP allegation and a 7.6% NEAR price drop. On-chain, USDC utilization sat at 84-86% except a spike to 93% after a single 1M USDC borrow at 15:49 on 21 Oct, which eased overnight. Held token balances matched ledger liquidity throughout.

positions_considered.description: Supplies native USDC (~$1,000) on Rhea Lend, no debt
wNEAR collateral, native USDC debt, health factor about 1.6

t_first_public_signal.description: None. The only alert-like item is the 1M USDC whale borrow (utilization 85% -> 93%) at 15:49 on 21 Oct.

t_point_of_no_return.definition: Not applicable. USDC ledger-available liquidity never fell below 0.86M, and held balances always matched the ledger.

other_markers.name: minor_alert_utilization_spike
other_markers.description: Single 1M USDC borrow; USDC utilization 93.16% at 16:05, back to 86.5% by 07:52 on 22 Oct.

outcome_passive_holder.outcome: Nothing happened. Withdrawals were available throughout; liquidity was at least 0.86M USDC.
Nothing happened. NEAR traded 4.63-5.45, a health factor of 1.6 stayed far from 1, and collateral was withdrawable (wNEAR held ~2.86-3.03M).

ground_truth.outcome_price_only_rule: No trigger. NEAR's largest 4h swing was about -9% (5.45 to ~4.88 between 21 and 22 Oct); health-factor and LTV rules stay silent. Utilization rules with a 90% threshold would fire from about 15:49 on 21 Oct to 02:00 on 22 Oct, a false alarm.

ideal_action.rationale: Routine market; the utilization spike came from one borrower and was not a run.

expected_judge_labels.rationale: Routine posts and news; USDC utilization ~85% is normal for this market since reopening.
Utilization 93% after one whale borrow; liquidity 0.86M is still ample for a ~$1k supplier. Watch, do not exit.
No relevant risk; NEAR moves within normal range; the USDC utilization spike raises the borrow rate slightly but does not threaten the position.
